Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Owns a PostgreSQL enum catalog entry, including its label OID and server sort position.
SortOrder follows PostgreSQL declaration and ALTER TYPE ordering, independently of C# numeric values.

```csharp
public sealed record PgEnumInfo : IEquatable<PgEnumInfo>
```

### PgEnumInfo(string, uint, uint, float)

Owns a PostgreSQL enum catalog entry, including its label OID and server sort position.
SortOrder follows PostgreSQL declaration and ALTER TYPE ordering, independently of C# numeric values.


Parameters:

`Label` — [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

The exact label decoded from the server encoding.

The catalog's sort position, which may be fractional after adding labels.
